svg.text: Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Architecture — Medical Image Classification
⚠ Simplified for clarity — this diagram shows only ONE Convolution + Pooling block.
Real CNNs (e.g. VGG, ResNet) stack many such blocks (5–50+ layers), each learning progressively higher-level features.

▭ The small outlined squares mark the receptive field: a kernel of that same size is placed over the patch, its convolution is computed, and the single result replaces the corresponding pixel in the output feature map.
